title: Callouts
body: Short, scannable asides that sit beside the main text — a tip, a do, a don't.

_items.title: Tip
_items.text: Read the question twice before you plan, and underline the task word — analyse, compare, evaluate.

_items.title: Do
_items.text: Back each claim with evidence, and say in a sentence how that evidence supports your point.

_items.title: Don't
_items.text: Don't pad the word count with description the question never asked for.
